verdict.rationale: Kintsugi has an OpenAPI spec: its SDKs and API reference are generated from it, and its first-party MCP server exposes the live spec to AI assistants. No documented download URL exists, though, and probes of common openapi.json/swagger.json paths returned 404. That probe only tested guessed paths and does not contradict any vendor claim, so this is partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: a documented, directly downloadable spec URL or file, and independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved outside MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
